messages:
lia: quick update 389 NovaMed listing is live on Azure Marketplace with the co-sell badge: https://azuremarketplace.microsoft.com/listing/novamed-redwood-clinical-summaries

maya: incredible news!! :tada: huge kudos to partnerships and eng. what's the plan for a customer highlight?

kevin: engineering note: we validated the tenant-scoped deployment and the ARM template installs cleanly. pushed a tiny fix to the helm chart (imagePullPolicy). snippet I used:

```
apiVersion: v1
kind: Pod
spec:
  containers:
  - name: redwood-inference
    image: registry.redwood.ai/redwood:stable
    imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
```

sam: got verbal OK from NovaMed to share a short metric: "2.4x improvement in median report generation latency and ~33% lower inference spend per report." they also approved a 1-line exec quote.

ash: legal-bot cleared the co-marketing language. @legal-bot can confirm asset usage window?

legal-bot: automated: NovaMed logo and quote usage approved for 12 months; please attribute: "NovaMed (customer name). All rights reserved."

maya: perfect. lia, can you draft a 1-pager and a short case study? i'll take the blog draft and a social carousel. goal: publish next Tues.

lia: will do. tracking to create: partnership asset page, case study draft, quickstart snippet, demo sandbox with NovaMed sample dataset (anonymized). assigning tasks on board now.

kevin: note for runtime: we saw a memory spike at 1:30pm during their canary, turned out to be a missing kv-cache disable flag in their integration. filed a small fix in runtime to default to safe kv-cache settings.

sam: getting the VP of Engineering quote from NovaMed now. they want the blog to highlight production reliability and reduced cost.

marketing-bot: automated: draft social post created (ID: mkt_4432). scheduled internal review for 2026-04-02 17:00 UTC.

deploy-bot: automated: partner announcement added to all-hands queue (slide slot reserved).

maya: tiny ask for sales ops: once the case study is final, can we drop a 30-second snippet into the in-app quickstart so reps can demo the flow?

lia: yes. i'll add the snippet and a permalink to the demo workspace.

maya: thanks team. big win 680 let's celebrate in the #all-hands and with a short shoutout on socials once legal publishes the assets."
